key_findings: Cross-pipeline vocabulary: 69K unique words, 2.2K core shared by all 7 pipelines
Response format: Code 86% code+text, Creative 84% prose, 9 format categories identified
Question complexity: DocQA most complex (22.7), Self-Inversion simplest (12.9)
Density-diversity inverse correlation r=-0.724 in embedding space
Information density: Creative highest (63.6), Math lowest (42.5)
N-gram overlap: 1.19M unique bigrams, ComplexQA-SelfInv most shared
Spectral: Self-Inv PR=61.6 highest, PR-Vendi correlation r=0.970
Isotropy: DocQA most isotropic, Code least; combining improves uniformity
Domain coverage: 2,366 domains, 99.8% single-source, Self-Inv discovers 2,288
Interpolation: Creative-DocQA smoothest transition, Code-DocQA sharpest
Composite ranking: DocQA #1, Self-Inv #2, Complex QA #3, Math #7
Cumulative: 180 figures, 27 tables, 70+ reports across 7 sessions
